title: angry
description: Crouched forward, shaking with rage: angry, upset.

title: confused
description: Head tilted to one side, peering forward: confused, not understanding.

title: dizzy
description: Chromapi circles twice, tilting with it: dizzy, after a bump.

title: excited
description: Four quick bounces, turning left and right: excited.

title: greeting
description: A front leg lifts and waves once, the weight on the other three: hello, goodbye.

title: happy
description: Three little hops, swaying side to side: happy, pleased.

title: joy
description: Head up, rising a little, held: a proud, happy look.

title: kick
description: A front leg lifts, kicks forward once and comes back, the weight on the other three: playful.

title: no
description: Two shakes of the head, left and right: refusing, saying no.

title: purring
description: Low, swaying slowly side to side, as a cat rubbing against a leg: content, purring.

title: sad
description: Head down, sinking a little, then slowly back: sad, disappointed.

title: scared
description: Recoil backward and crouch, trembling: scared.

title: surprised
description: A jump back, head up, then slowly forward again: surprised.

title: tired
description: Sinking low, head down, swaying once, as in a yawn: tired, sleepy.

title: yes
description: Two nods of the head: agreeing, saying yes.
